industry.why: Neutral at industry level, carried, because the industry is split and the sector rows carry the view. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Chris Wood (via Jefferies, 17 Oct) would diversify from artificial intelligence into healthcare and financials, and Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: B now, C prior at industry level, with Medtech capital goods at A; but pharmaceuticals against medical technology was not spoken to by any source, clinical-stage biotech is the unproven, cash-burning end the Fragility axis punishes (B.11 at D, relative strength F), and only five of the 149 Pool stocks are healthcare. Pharma/biotech and Hospitals carry B. Counter-case for B at the industry: 94 stocks, the second largest industry, and a defensive rotation that is now five weeks old; for D: a crowded destination.

sector.why: Underweight, set deliberately this week (the carried B was inherited from the old Pharma/biotech row, whose reason was large, proven, cash-yielding pharma; clinical-stage biotech is the opposite case). Component 1 regime, 16-Oct-26 (a discount-rate shock with the first credit crack inside the artificial intelligence chain: United States core inflation re-accelerating on energy, the Fed and Bank of England hikes pulled forward, the US 10-year about 5.1%, the US joined the sell-off and Asia is in washout, defensives bid for four weeks in Europe, European breadth off its three-year lows but in the bottom quarter, the consumer forecast to weaken into winter; sources present 2026-W42): unproven, cash-burning, long-duration, financed at the margin, the profile the Fragility axis and the discount-rate read say the market is refusing this week, and no source spoke to biotech. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-16 against 2026-08-14, not week on week: F now, C prior, agrees. Counter-case: seven stocks, binary outcomes that do not follow the discount rate, and the sector is small enough that one trial result reorders it; the Fragility axis already scores their size, so this row carries one notch, not two.

geography.why: Double Underweight, carried. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): the French ten-year premium reached a record 150 basis points, 'a lot for a core European country' (Pacific, 26 October), the 2027 deficit is seen at 5.4% of output (Goldman Sachs, 25 October), euro-exposed assets underperformed their global betas because of France (GOAL, 26 October), 2027's 300 billion of issuance makes this 'just the warmup' and the election in May or June 2027 is the earliest point anything changes; against it, Moody's affirmation removed a sovereign tail risk (DNB Carnegie, 26 October) and the French Hidden Champions newsletter sees institutional outflows from French small and mid caps as a contrarian set-up. Ten Pool names, TotalEnergies at rank 24 near the Bench cut with a global revenue base the row does not describe well. Counter-case: the affirmation and the contrarian set-up. To D on the premium under 120 basis points for a month; back to C under 100.
